Read only current facts and enumerate every explicitly stated supported kinship relationship with one stable opaque source key and a source witness. Copy the exact cue, its bearer, and the person whose relative the bearer is. Copy start or end only when the source expressly dates that kinship relationship; otherwise use null only after a complete grammatical scan. Work, payment, service, residence, marriage, birth, enrollment, location, and query dates remain attached to their own events and are not kinship dates. Return unread when direction, date attachment, or completeness is ambiguous.
Read facts only. Preserve current source keys. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
